title: The Hunters' Mark
text: Fresh blood on the stones, bright and wet, a trail of it leading away between the rocks. It is not your blood. The quarry is hurt. It is making for somewhere it thinks is safe, no longer careful of the trail it leaves.

options.label: The best tracker follows the blood wherever it leads, eager to finish what was started.

outcomes.text: The blood runs straight and fresh, a shortcut through the rocks to the very mouth of its lair.
The trail ends in a pool that was poured, not bled. The blood was bait; the quarry is already behind you.

options.label: Keep to the path and let it bleed. Wounded things are the most dangerous.

outcomes.text: The path is slower but safer. When at last you come upon the quarry, you do so from cover, with the Leader ready before it is.
